description: Check bookmark URLs or Canvas packages, compare sources with host-led research, and retain verifiable reports.

interface.shortDescription: Bookmark research with sources · 书签研究与来源核验
interface.longDescription: Check ordinary bookmark URLs or Canvas packages, compare sources, or investigate the complete input with host-led research. 普通链接可直接查证，画布保留原有语境；按需比较或深研，核验证据与完整覆盖，保存报告，并可整理为 Wiki。
defaultPrompt: Quick check / 快速查证：Read my selected bookmark and answer with sources. 读取指定书签并带来源回答。
Compare / 主动搜索：Compare tools in my selected bookmarks and follow evidence gaps. 比较指定书签并补查证据。
Deep research / 深度研究：Research every URL in my bookmark list or package and save a sourced report. 完整研究书签清单或数据包，保留覆盖记录与报告。
